meta.notes: Demon's Souls crafting and upgrade data, PS5 remake (2020) first. Demon's Souls has no item-combining crafting: 'crafting' here means blacksmith upgrade paths, Demon Soul transformations, Colorless Demon Soul upgrades, Demon Soul trades for spells and miracles, Sparkly the Crow trades, and farming spots. Path recipes list stone tiers; total counts differ per weapon (range given in each material note). Build variants (Crescent Estoc, Sharp Uchigatana, etc.) have exact totals from that weapon's Fextralife table. Remake-only: some Sparkly trades (marked), Penetrator set key, Ring of Longevity and Providential Ring trades. PS3 names: Moonshadestone = Darkmoonstone, Marrowstone = Pulpstone, God's Wrath = Rage of God. Fextralife pages disagree on the Large Sword of Searching base weapon; the item pages' list is given alongside the Boss Soul Weapons table.

categories.name: Normal / Regular upgrades (+0 to +10)
categories.description: Hardstone (STR weapons, bows, most shields) or Sharpstone (DEX weapons, Spiked Shield). Shard → Large Shard → Chunk → Pure. Boldwin (Nexus) and Ed (Stonefang Tunnel) both do these.

categories.name: Quality path (Clearstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 35 melee weapons and 4 bows. Requires Clearstone. Yields equal STR and DEX bonuses. Boldwin can do Clearstone; all other special stones need Blacksmith Ed.

categories.name: Crushing path (Greystone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 15 melee weapons. Requires Greystone. Yields high STR bonus, but removes the DEX bonus. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Sharp path (Bladestone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 20 melee weapons and 1 shield. Requires Bladestone. Yields high DEX bonus, but lowers the STR bonus. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Dragon path (Dragonstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 15 melee weapons. Requires Dragonstone. Yields high base damage and adds fire damage, but removes all stat bonuses. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Tearing path (Suckerstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 11 melee weapons. Requires Suckerstone. Yields high DEX bonus, lowers the STR bonus, and adds Bleed damage. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Mercury path (Mercurystone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 20 melee weapons. Requires Mercurystone. Yields middling DEX bonus, lowers the STR bonus, and adds Poison damage. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Fatal path (Marrowstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 9 melee weapons. Requires Marrowstone. Lowers the base damage and STR bonus, but yields high DEX bonus and adds Critical damage which is bonus damage applied to backstabs and ripostes. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Moon path (Moonlightstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 28 melee weapons. Requires Moonlightstone. Lowers the STR and DEX bonuses but adds magic damage with decent Magic bonus. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Crescent path (Moonshadestone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 14 melee weapons. Requires Moonshadestone. Removes the STR and DEX bonuses but adds magic damage with high Magic bonus. Also adds MP regen of +1 per 5~3 seconds. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Blessed path (Faintstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 15 melee weapons. Requires Faintstone. Lowers the STR and DEX bonuses but adds magic damage with high Faith bonus. Also adds HP regen of +2~6 per second. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Sticky path (Spiderstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 4 bows. Requires Spiderstone. Yields high DEX bonus but lowers the STR bonus, and increases the bow's Range by 5. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Dark path (Cloudstone)
categories.description: +1 to +5. For 7 shields. Requires Cloudstone. Increases Magic damage reduction, but lowers Guard Break Reduction. Needs Blacksmith Ed (Stonefang Tunnel).

categories.name: Colorless Demon Soul upgrades
categories.description: Unique weapons and shields (Kris Blade, Large Sword of Moonlight, Makoto, Dark Silver Shield, etc.) can only be upgraded with Colorless Demon Souls at Blacksmith Ed, after he has received the Searing Demon Soul.

categories.name: Boss soul weapons (Demon Soul transformations)
categories.description: Blacksmith Ed turns a base weapon at the required level plus a specific boss Demon Soul into a unique weapon. Needs the Searing Demon Soul (Flamelurker) given to Ed first.

categories.name: Demon Soul trades (spells, miracles, souls)
categories.description: Every boss Demon Soul can be consumed for souls or traded to Sage Freke, Yuria, Saint Urbain or Blacksmith Ed.

categories.name: Sparkly the Crow trades
categories.description: Drop an item by the crow's nest in Island's Edge (Shrine of Storms 4-1); reload or leave the world to collect what she gives back. Each trade works once per playthrough. Demon's Souls has no item-combining or crafting of consumables; Sparkly trades are the closest thing.

categories.name: Blacksmith services
categories.description: Reverting upgrades, unlocking advanced upgrades, and buying stones.

categories.name: Farming spots
categories.description: Where to farm stones. Pure Black World Tendency raises drop rates (Wikidot, Twinfinite). Wikidot methods were written for PS3 (2009), where Moonshadestone was "Darkmoonstone", Marrowstone was "Pulpstone" and God's Wrath was "Rage of God".

items.name: Regular +10 (Hardstone or Sharpstone)
items.description: +0 to +10. For 35 melee weapons, 4 bows and 8 shields. Requires Hardstone or Sharpstone. For weapons, yields high base damage but relatively poor scaling.
